messages:
maria (support): Heads-up — customer reported 403 when switching into project 'acme-prod' right after their IdP rotated JWKs earlier today. Console shows "403 Permission Denied". Anyone seen this pattern?

tom (sre): Yep, similar to a token signature validation cache miss.

lee (infra): Can you paste repro steps + any request id / headers so we can trace?

maria (support): Repro steps: 1) SSO login, 2) click org switch -> project list loads, 3) click project -> 403. User token still not expired (exp > now). Request ID: rq_0a1b2c3d. From auth logs: "token_signature_invalid" at 12:10:05 UTC. Header snippet (truncated): "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6"

jessica (eng): If the IdP rotated keys, tokens new-issued will have a different kid. Our JWKS cache could be stale. Can you fetch the IdP /.well-known/jwks.json and compare kid list?

lee (infra): To reproduce locally: curl -s https://idp.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq .keys[].kid ; compare with the kid used in token. I see cached_jwks_kid: oldkey123 in our auth-proxy logs.

tom (sre): Short-term workaround: force SSO re-auth (logout) or invalidate the session on our side to force fetching the new JWKS. maria, can you try revoking the user's session?

maria (support): I revoked session via admin portal for acme.jane@example.com and asked them to re-login. User re-auth'd and confirmed project access restored.

jessica (eng): Root cause: IdP rotated JWKs and tokens were signed with the new kid while our JWKS cache TTL (1h) hadn't refreshed. We don't currently trigger immediate fetch on signature-verify failure. Action: add fallback to fetch JWKS on token_signature_invalid and emit a metric.

tom (sre): Created INFRA-3421 to implement immediate JWKS refetch on sigfail + metric + runbook. Also please add an alert: sigfail spike >5/min.

lee (infra): Alert created in pagerduty as P3 for now. Added runbook link.

maria (support): Closing this thread — user confirmed access and we logged the RCA in ticket 12345. Notes: no SCIM resync required; roles were intact. :white_check_mark:
